name: trae-daily-signin
description: Automate the daily check-in of TRAE desktop client to collect points, with a safe click strategy that never steals focus on Windows.

description.en: Open the TRAE desktop account menu and click the daily check-in button to collect points. Windows verified; macOS experimental; mobile clients have no check-in entry.
description.zh-cn: 打开 TRAE 桌面端账户菜单并点击每日签到按钮领取积分。Windows 已验证可用，macOS 实验性支持，手机端无签到入口。
